experiment_type: multi-seed NSGA-II with cost and quantity-weighted delivery time

files.fronts.csv: unique feasible non-dominated objective points in each run's observational search archive
files.representative_solutions.csv: objective values and roles for union-front solutions
files.representative_allocations.csv: shipment quantities and arc sequences for union-front solutions
files.found_configuration_solutions.csv: all distinct route-allocation configurations found at retained union-front objective coordinates; not an enumeration of all possible configurations
files.found_configuration_allocations.csv: complete shipment allocations for the distinct found configurations
files.run_endpoint_solutions.csv: deterministically selected cost/time endpoints for every seed
files.run_endpoint_allocations.csv: complete allocations for the seed-level endpoint solutions

note: The external search archive is observational and is not used in selection, so it does not change the NSGA-II evaluation budget or search pressure. It retains distinct configurations found during the run. Comparator algorithms and scenarios must use the same evaluation budget and shared normalization bounds.
